title: Add notification preferences to user-service
description:
Add a notification_preferences table and a last_login_at column to the users table so the new weekly digest-email feature can target opted-in users.

Scope:
- Add last_login_at column to users table
- Create notification_preferences table (FK to users)
- Add supporting indexes
- Default existing active users to opted-in weekly digests
- Purely additive schema change; no data deletion

Migration file: migrations/005_add_notification_prefs.sql. Follow the standard migration runbook.
scope: Additive schema change to user-service: add notification_preferences table and users.last_login_at column. No data deletion.
